@Test
public void testCreateMVForListPartitionTable() throws Exception {
    createTable("CREATE TABLE test.list_tbl (
" + "city VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
" + "user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
" + "date DATE NOT NULL,
" + "age SMALLINT NOT NULL,
" + "sex TINYINT NOT NULL,

" + ") DUPLICATE KEY(city) PARTITION BY LIST(city) (
" + "PARTITION p_bj

    createMaterializedView("create materialized view list_view as

" + "group by
" + "city,
" + "user_id,
" + "date;");
    Map<Long, AlterJobV2> alterJobs = Env.getCurrentEnv().getMaterializedViewHandler().getAlterJobsV2();
    waitAlterJobDone(alterJobs);
}

@Test
public void testAbnormal() throws DdlException, ConfigException {
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "Unknown properties: {aa=bb}", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl1
" + "(k1 int, k2 float)
" + "duplicate key(k1)
" + "distributed by hash(k1) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1','aa'='bb'); "));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "Floating point type should not be used in distribution column", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl1
" + "(k1 int, k2 float)
" + "duplicate key(k1)
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1'); "));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(AnalysisException.class, "Floating point type column can not be partition column", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl3
" + "(k1 int, k2 int, k3 float)
" + "duplicate key(k1)
" + "partition by range(k3)
" + "(partition p1 values less than("10"))
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1'); "));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "Varchar should not in the middle of short keys", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl3
" + "(k1 varchar(40), k2 int, k3 int)
" + "duplicate key(k1, k2, k3)
" + "distributed by hash(k1) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1', 'short_key' = '3');"));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "Short key is too large. should less than: 3", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl4
" + "(k1 int, k2 int, k3 int)
" + "duplicate key(k1, k2, k3)
" + "distributed by hash(k1) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1', 'short_key' = '4');"));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "replication num should be less than the number of available backends. replication num is 4, available backend num is 3", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl5
" + "(k1 int, k2 int, k3 int)
" + "duplicate key(k1, k2, k3)
" + "distributed by hash(k1) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '4');"));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsNoException(() -> createTable("create table test.atbl6
" + "(k1 int, k2 int)
" + "duplicate key(k1)
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1'); "));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "Table 'atbl6' already exists", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl6
" + "(k1 int, k2 int, k3 int)
" + "duplicate key(k1, k2, k3)
" + "distributed by hash(k1) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1');"));
    ConfigBase.setMutableConfig("disable_storage_medium_check", "false");
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "Failed to find enough backend, please check the replication num,replication tag and storage medium and avail capacity of backends " + "or maybe all be on same host." + Env.getCurrentSystemInfo().getDetailsForCreateReplica(new ReplicaAllocation((short) 1)) + "
" + "Create failed replications:
" + "replication tag: {"location" : "default"}, replication num: 1, storage medium: SSD", () -> createTable("create table test.tb7(key1 int, key2 varchar(10)) distributed by hash(key1) 
" + "buckets 1 properties('replication_num' = '1', 'storage_medium' = 'ssd');"));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "Failed to find enough backend, please check the replication num,replication tag and storage medium and avail capacity of backends " + "or maybe all be on same host." + Env.getCurrentSystemInfo().getDetailsForCreateReplica(new ReplicaAllocation((short) 1)) + "
" + "Create failed replications:
" + "replication tag: {"location" : "default"}, replication num: 1, storage medium: SSD", () -> createTable("create table test.tb7_1(key1 int, key2 varchar(10))
" + "PARTITION BY RANGE(`key1`) (
" + "    PARTITION `p1` VALUES LESS THAN ("10"),
" + "    PARTITION `p2` VALUES LESS THAN ("20"),
" + "    PARTITION `p3` VALUES LESS THAN ("30"))
" + "distributed by hash(key1)
" + "buckets 1 properties('replication_num' = '1', 'storage_medium' = 'ssd');"));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "sequence column only support UNIQUE_KEYS", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl8
" + "(k1 varchar(40), k2 int, v1 int sum)
" + "aggregate key(k1, k2)
" + "partition by range(k2)
" + "(partition p1 values less than("10"))
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1',
" + "'function_column.sequence_type' = 'int');"));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "sequence type only support integer types and date types", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl8
" + "(k1 varchar(40), k2 int, v1 int)
" + "unique key(k1, k2)
" + "partition by range(k2)
" + "(partition p1 values less than("10"))
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1',
" + "'function_column.sequence_type' = 'double');"));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "The sequence_col and sequence_type cannot be set at the same time", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl8
" + "(k1 varchar(40), k2 int, v1 int)
" + "unique key(k1, k2)
" + "partition by range(k2)
" + "(partition p1 values less than("10"))
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1',
" + "'function_column.sequence_type' = 'int', 'function_column.sequence_col' = 'v1');"));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "The specified sequence column[v3] not exists", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl8
" + "(k1 varchar(40), k2 int, v1 int)
" + "unique key(k1, k2)
" + "partition by range(k2)
" + "(partition p1 values less than("10"))
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1',
" + "'function_column.sequence_col' = 'v3');"));
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "Sequence type only support integer types and date types", () -> createTable("create table test.atbl8
" + "(k1 varchar(40), k2 int, v1 int)
" + "unique key(k1, k2)
" + "partition by range(k2)
" + "(partition p1 values less than("10"))
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1',
" + "'function_column.sequence_col' = 'k1');"));
    /**
     * create table with list partition
     */
    // single partition column with single key
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(AnalysisException.class, "input", () -> createTable("create table test.tbl9
" + "(k1 int not null, k2 varchar(128), k3 int, v1 int, v2 int)
" + "partition by list(k1)
" + "(
" + "partition p1 values in ("1"),
" + "partition p2 values in ()
" + ")
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1');"));
    // single partition column with multi keys
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(org.apache.doris.common.AnalysisException.class, "partition item's size out of partition columns: Index 1 out of bounds for length 1", () -> createTable("create table test.tbl10
" + "(k1 int not null, k2 varchar(128), k3 int, v1 int, v2 int)
" + "partition by list(k1)
" + "(
" + "partition p1 values in ("1", "3", "5"),
" + "partition p2 values in ("2", "4", "6"),
" + "partition p3 values in (("7", "8"))
" + ")
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1');"));
    // multi partition columns with single key
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(IllegalArgumentException.class, "partition key desc list size[1] is not equal to partition column size[2]", () -> createTable("create table test.tbl11
" + "(k1 int not null, k2 varchar(128) not null, k3 int, v1 int, v2 int)
" + "partition by list(k1, k2)
" + "(
" + "partition p1 values in (("1", "beijing")),
" + "partition p2 values in ("2", "beijing")
" + ")
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1');"));
    // multi partition columns with multi keys
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(org.apache.doris.common.AnalysisException.class, "partition item's size out of partition columns: Index 2 out of bounds for length 2", () -> createTable("create table test.tbl12
" + "(k1 int not null, k2 varchar(128) not null, k3 int, v1 int, v2 int)
" + "partition by list(k1, k2)
" + "(
" + "partition p1 values in (("1", "beijing"), ("1", "shanghai")),
" + "partition p2 values in (("2", "beijing"), ("2", "shanghai")),
" + "partition p3 values in (("3", "tianjin", "3"))
" + ")
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1');"));
    // multi partition columns with multi keys
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(AnalysisException.class, "input", () -> createTable("create table test.tbl13
" + "(k1 int not null, k2 varchar(128) not null, k3 int, v1 int, v2 int)
" + "partition by list(k1, k2)
" + "(
" + "partition p1 values in (("1", "beijing"), ("1", "shanghai")),
" + "partition p2 values in (("2", "beijing"), ("2", "shanghai")),
" + "partition p3 values in ()
" + ")
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 1
" + "properties('replication_num' = '1');"));
    /**
     * create table with both list and range partition
     */
    // list contain less than
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(AnalysisException.class, "invalid", () -> createTable("CREATE TABLE test.tbl14 (
" + "    k1 int not null, k2 varchar(128), k3 int, v1 int, v2 int
" + ")
" + "PARTITION BY LIST(k1)
" + "(
" + "    PARTITION p1 VALUES less than ("1"),
" + "    PARTITION p2 VALUES less than ("2"),
" + "    partition p3 values less than ("5")
" + ")DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(k2) BUCKETS 10
" + "PROPERTIES("replication_num" = "1");"));
    // range contain in
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(AnalysisException.class, "invalid", () -> createTable("CREATE TABLE test.tbl15 (
" + "    k1 int, k2 varchar(128), k3 int, v1 int, v2 int
" + ")
" + "PARTITION BY range(k1)
" + "(
" + "    PARTITION p1 VALUES in ("1"),
" + "    PARTITION p2 VALUES in ("2"),
" + "    partition p3 values in ("5")
" + ")DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(k2) BUCKETS 10
" + "PROPERTIES("replication_num" = "1");"));
    // list contain both
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(AnalysisException.class, "invalid", () -> createTable("CREATE TABLE test.tbl15 (
" + "    k1 int not null, k2 varchar(128), k3 int, v1 int, v2 int
" + ")
" + "PARTITION BY LIST(k1)
" + "(
" + "    PARTITION p1 VALUES in ("1"),
" + "    PARTITION p2 VALUES in ("2"),
" + "    partition p3 values less than ("5")
" + ")DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(k2) BUCKETS 10

    // range contain both
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(AnalysisException.class, "invalid", () -> createTable("CREATE TABLE test.tbl16 (

" + ")
" + "PARTITION BY RANGE(k1)

" + "    PARTITION p1 VALUES less than ("1"),
" + "    PARTITION p2 VALUES less than ("2"),
" + "    partition p3 values in ("5")

    // range: partition content != partition key type

@Test
public void testCreateTableWithMinLoadReplicaNum() throws Exception {
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsNoException(() -> createTable("create table test.tbl_min_load_replica_num_1
" + "(k1 int, k2 int)
" + "duplicate key(k1)
" + "distributed by hash(k1) buckets 1
" + "properties(
" + " 'replication_num' = '2',
" + " 'min_load_replica_num' = '1'
" + ");"));
    Database db = Env.getCurrentInternalCatalog().getDbOrDdlException("test");
    OlapTable tbl1 = (OlapTable) db.getTableOrDdlException("tbl_min_load_replica_num_1");
    Assert.assertEquals(1, tbl1.getMinLoadReplicaNum());
    Assert.assertEquals(2, (int) tbl1.getDefaultReplicaAllocation().getTotalReplicaNum());
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsNoException(() -> alterTableSync("alter table test.tbl_min_load_replica_num_1
" + " set ( 'min_load_replica_num' = '2');"));
    Assert.assertEquals(2, tbl1.getMinLoadReplicaNum());
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "Failed to check min load replica num", () -> alterTableSync("alter table test.tbl_min_load_replica_num_1
" + " set ( 'min_load_replica_num' = '3');"));
    Assert.assertEquals(2, tbl1.getMinLoadReplicaNum());
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "min_load_replica_num should > 0 or =-1", () -> alterTableSync("alter table test.tbl_min_load_replica_num_1
" + " set ( 'min_load_replica_num' = '-3');"));

" + "(k1 int, k2 int)
" + "duplicate key(k1)
" + "distributed by hash(k1) buckets 1
" + "properties(
" + " 'replication_num' = '2',
" + " 'min_load_replica_num' = '3'
" + ");"));

" + " 'min_load_replica_num' = '1'
" + ");"));
    OlapTable tbl3 = (OlapTable) db.getTableOrDdlException("tbl_min_load_replica_num_3");
    Assert.assertEquals(1, tbl3.getMinLoadReplicaNum());
    ExceptionChecker.expectThrowsWithMsg(DdlException.class, "Failed to check min load replica num", () -> createTable("create table test.tbl_min_load_replica_num_4
" + "(k1 date, k2 int, k3 int)
" + "unique key(k1, k2)
" + "partition by range(k1)()
" + "distributed by hash(k2) buckets 2
" + "properties(
" + " 'dynamic_partition.enable' = 'true',
" + " 'dynamic_partition.time_unit' = 'DAY',
